hypothesis: M205 gives repeat-stable stage5 evidence from the M202 parent while M204 remains the best fixed-loss retained stage5 checkpoint. A single short guarded stage6 from M204 can be tested.
success_criteria: start from runs/ppo_m204_stage5_from_m202_seed5209/checkpoint.pt because it is the lowest fixed-loss retained stage5 checkpoint
run only one short guarded stage6 before any repeat or longer continuation
keep M194 as the strong action anchor
preserve old M183 M168/M170 replay gates and refreshed M193 M189 replay gate
compare fixed M193 objective against M204 and M205 before accepting any repeat
failure_criteria: run multiple stage6 seeds before the first stage6 gate passes
run a longer PPO continuation directly
drop any M183 or M193 replay row
promote based on fixed objective improvement alone
